description: Mask region-based convolutional neural network (R-CNN) models for extracting building footprints from remote sensing data is a data set deposited in University of Pretoria by its authors Khumeleni Makungo. These trained deep learning are trained to extract building footprints from high-resolution aerial imagery and LiDAR-derived nDSM with a spatial resolution of 20cm or less. These models were used to extract footprints in formal residential zones, industrial zones, and informal settlement zones within the City of Cape Town. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 985099983 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
